title: Absalom Returns

questions.question: Who perceived that the king's heart went out to Absalom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:1 (ESV): "Now Joab the son of Zeruiah knew that the king's heart went out to Absalom."

questions.question: Where did Joab find a wise woman?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:2 (ESV): "And Joab sent to Tekoa and brought from there a wise woman..."

questions.question: What story did the wise woman tell David?
options: Two sons fought and one killed the other
questions.correctAnswer: Two sons fought and one killed the other
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:6 (ESV): "And your servant had two sons, and they quarreled... and one struck the other and killed him."

questions.question: Who did David realize was behind the woman's speech?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:19 (ESV): "The king said, 'Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?'"

questions.question: Did David allow Absalom to see his face immediately upon return?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:24 (ESV): "And the king said, 'Let him dwell apart in his own house; he is not to come into my presence.'"

questions.question: What physical feature of Absalom was praised?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:25-26 (ESV): "Now in all Israel there was no one so much to be praised for his handsome appearance... And when he cut the hair of his head..."

questions.question: How much did Absalom's hair weigh when he cut it?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:26 (ESV): "...he weighed the hair of his head, 200 shekels by the king's weight."

questions.question: How many children did Absalom have?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:27 (ESV): "There were born to Absalom three sons, and one daughter whose name was Tamar."

questions.question: How long did Absalom dwell in Jerusalem without seeing the king's face?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:28 (ESV): "So Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, without coming into the king's presence."

questions.question: What did Absalom do to get Joab to come to him?
options: Set his barley field on fire
questions.correctAnswer: Set his barley field on fire
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:30 (ESV): "...See, Joab's field is next to mine... go and set it on fire."

questions.question: The wise woman said "We must all die; we are like ______ spilled on the ground."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:14 (ESV): "We must all die; we are like water spilled on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again."

questions.question: God devises means so that the ______ one will not remain an outcast.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:14 (ESV): "...and he devises means so that the banished one will not remain an outcast."

questions.question: What was the name of Absalom's daughter?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:27 (ESV): "...and one daughter whose name was Tamar. She was a beautiful woman."

questions.question: What did the wise woman pretend to be?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 14:2 (ESV): "...Pretend to be a mourner and put on mourning garments..."

questions.question: What did David ultimately do to Absalom?

key_verse_text: We must all die; we are like water spilled on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again. But God will not take away life, and he devises means so that the banished one will not remain an outcast. (ESV)
